title: Police seize P6.5-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes in Misamis Occidental

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A pre-dawn checkpoint operation in Misamis Occidental thwarted an attempt to transport nearly P6.5 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes bound for Central Luzon, leading to the arrest of two couriers early Tuesday.
